produto.assinatura: Your origins. Your stories. Your legacy.

landing.promessa: No story that matters should be lost.
landing.titulo: A home for your family memory
landing.p1: Photographs, documents, letters, recipes, recordings and the stories told at home — kept together, with who told it, when, and where it came from.
landing.p2: Origena preserves the origin of every piece of information. When two people remember it differently, both versions stay.
landing.fechado_p: The platform is under development and runs today in closed beta, with a single family.

campo.aceito_termos: I accept the terms of use

conta.confirme_p: Open the link we sent to confirm and sign in.
conta.entre_com_email: Sign in with {email} to accept the invitation.
conta.mfa_ativa: It is on. When you sign in, besides your password we ask for the 6-digit code from your app — so whoever discovers your password still cannot reach the family archive.
conta.mfa_inativa: It is off. While it stays off you cannot invite anyone: inviting grants access to everyone's memory, and that door does not open with a password alone.
conta.mfa_passo1: 1. Open an authenticator app on your phone (Google Authenticator, Authy, Microsoft Authenticator, or the password manager you already use) and point the camera at the image below.
conta.mfa_passo2: 2. Prefer to type? This is the key:
conta.mfa_passo3: 3. Enter the 6 numbers your app shows
conta.mfa_backup_p: Each code works ONCE, for the day you lose your phone. This is the only time they appear — afterwards not even we can show them again. Print them or keep them somewhere safe.
conta.mfa_ligada: Done: two-step verification is on. You can now invite your family.
conta.mfa_confirmar_desligar: Turn off two-step verification? While it is off you will not be able to invite anyone.
conta.mfa_desligar_p: Confirm your password to turn it off:
conta.sessoes_p: Ends your session on every device, including this one. Use it if you lose your phone or think someone got into your account.
conta.sessoes_confirmar: Sign out on every device? You will need to sign in here again too.

estado.falhou_p: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was lost — just try again.
estado.offline_p: Your device seems to be offline. The archive is intact and nothing you wrote was lost — when the connection is back, just try again.
estado.sem_permissao: This area is not open to your role
estado.sem_permissao_p: Whoever administers the family can change that. The archive is whole — what changes is how much each person reaches.
estado.so_leitura: You follow the archive but do not add to it here. Whoever administers the family can change that whenever they want.

nav.acervo_d: People, memories, stories, traditions, objects and interviews — everything the family has kept so far.
nav.explorar_d: The same story from other angles: in time, on the map, in search, and in questions to Origena.
nav.criar_d: The archive becomes a book, an album, a time capsule — without typing anything again.
nav.legado_d: What is missing, what does not match between versions, who looks after the archive and who has access.
nav.adicionar_titulo: What would you like to keep?
nav.adicionar_intro: It does not need to be complete or in order. A photo with no date, a half-told story, a name only your aunt remembers — all of it is already a beginning.
nav.add_memoria_d: Photos, videos, audio and documents. The original is kept exactly as it arrived.
nav.add_pessoa_d: Someone in the family, living or not. An approximate date is fine: "around 1940" is an answer.
nav.add_historia_d: That story that always comes back to the table. Write it your way — it keeps your name and the date.
nav.add_entrevista_d: Record someone telling it, right here on your phone. The original audio is never replaced.
nav.add_tradicao_d: A recipe, a celebration, a song, a saying, a family craft — with the handwritten page beside it, if there is one.
nav.add_reliquia_d: An object passed from hand to hand, with the line of who kept it over time.

mfa.exigido: Turn on two-step verification to do this.
mfa.porque: This action can expose or transfer the family archive.
mfa.exigido_convite: To invite someone, first turn on two-step verification — this action can expose the family archive.

mensagem.cadastro_enviado: We sent a confirmation link to your e-mail.
mensagem.cadastro_talvez: If this e-mail is available, we sent a confirmation link.
mensagem.recuperacao_enviada: If there is an account with this e-mail, we sent instructions.
mensagem.acesso_revogado: Access revoked. What this person contributed stays in the archive.
mensagem.pessoa_arquivada: The person was archived. Nothing was deleted — it can be restored.
mensagem.divergencia_preservada: Version accepted. The others are still kept and can be consulted at any time.
mensagem.revisao_preserva: We kept the new version. The previous one stays in the history.
mensagem.midia_arquivada: The file was archived. Nothing was deleted — it can be restored.
mensagem.historia_guardada: Saved. Who told it and when are kept alongside.
mensagem.versao_preservada: We kept the new version. The previous one is still available.
mensagem.nome_historico_preservado: Name updated. The old name is still kept and findable.
mensagem.tradicao_arquivada: The tradition went to the bin and can come back.
mensagem.reliquia_arquivada: The object went to the bin and can come back.
mensagem.missao_nao_volta: This question will not be asked again.

familia.nenhuma: You are not part of any family yet. Create yours.
familia.historico_vazio_p: Every change in the archive lands here with the name of who made it and when — including the ones the platform makes.
familia.confirmar_remocao: Remove this person's access? What they contributed stays in the archive.
familia.sem_parentes_p: Linking parents, children or a marriage is what makes the tree exist — and what lets this person be found from the others.
familia.confirmar_desligar: Unlink these two people? The tie disappears; nobody is deleted.
familia.divergencias_intro: A disagreement is not an error: it is two people remembering the same fact differently. Here both versions stay, with who told each one.
familia.divergencias_vazio_p: When someone records a date or a name different from what is already in the archive, both versions appear here — and neither is deleted.

papel.desc_HISTORIAN: Historian — takes care of sources and disagreements
papel.desc_EDITOR: Editor — organises and corrects the archive
papel.desc_GUEST: Guest — sees only what is public to the family

pessoa.arquivar_confirmar: Archive {nome}? The person disappears from the lists and the tree, but is NOT deleted: what they contributed stays in the archive, and it can be restored later from the Bin.
pessoa.arquivada: Person archived. They stay in the Bin, with what they contributed preserved.
pessoa.menor_ligado: Marked as a minor: the profile is now private.
pessoa.menor_explica: A minor — the profile stays private and never goes public. Unmarking does not reopen it: privacy stays as it is until you change it.
pessoa.sem_pessoas_p: Start with yourself, or with whoever the family most wants to remember. A name and an approximate year are enough — the rest comes later.
pessoa.ocultas: {n} person(s) do not appear for your role.
pessoa.ajuda_data: A year is enough. "Around 1940" and "the 1950s" are answers too.

parentesco.confirmo: The dates look odd, but they are right

fato.sem_fatos: Nothing recorded with a source yet
fato.sem_fatos_p: Every piece of information here keeps where it came from: who told it, or which document proved it. Start with what the family already knows by heart.
fato.preservadas: Versions that were not accepted are still kept — nothing is deleted.

contribuicao.sem_contribuicoes: Nobody has told anything about this person yet
contribuicao.sem_contribuicoes_p: One sentence is enough. The way they walked, the food they cooked, the habit everyone imitated — it is kept with your name and the date.

historia.titulo: Tell the story of this photo
historia.intro: Every answer becomes a memory kept with your name and today's date.
historia.obrigado: Saved. Who told it and when are kept alongside.

historia_mod.preservadas: Earlier versions are kept: nothing is overwritten.
historia_mod.sem_historias_p: Start with the one the family always repeats at the table. Write it your way — it is recorded with your name and today's date.
historia_mod.placeholder: My grandfather used to say that…

lixeira.explica: What was archived stays here and can come back. Nothing disappears with one click.
lixeira.intro: Everything deleted stays here and can come back whole, with the ties it had. Nothing is truly erased without a deletion request.

exportacao.explica: The zip has your data, the photos and the family tree in GEDCOM — open formats, readable without Origena.
exportacao.validade: The link works for a short time.
exportacao.nota_midias: Photos and videos remain downloadable one by one; the data and the history go complete in the file.

notificacao.intro: We only send what you ask for, and never the content itself.

entrevista.intro: Sitting down with someone and asking is the fastest way to save a lifetime of memory. Choose a guide, record the voice, and go at the pace of whoever is telling it — you can stop and come back later.
entrevista.escolha_roteiro: What are you going to talk about?
entrevista.escolha_pessoa: Who is going to tell it?
entrevista.sem_entrevistas: No interviews yet. The first one is usually the most valuable.
entrevista.pergunta_nova: Another question you want to ask
entrevista.transcricao_ia: Transcribed automatically — check it against the audio.
entrevista.transcricao_ia_corrigida: Automatic transcript checked by the family.
entrevista.sem_transcricao_provedor: Automatic transcription is not turned on yet. You can record the audio now and write the answer in your own words — the audio is kept either way.
entrevista.entidades: Look for names, dates and places
entrevista.entidades_intro: Origena reads the transcript and suggests what it found. Nothing becomes a fact until you say who it belongs to.
entrevista.audio_preservado: The original audio is kept as it is. The transcript is derived — it can be corrected as many times as needed.
entrevista.microfone_negado: The browser did not allow the microphone. Grant access or upload an audio file.
entrevista.microfone_indisponivel: This browser cannot record audio. Upload a file.
entrevista.d_infancia: The house, the street, the games, and what only a child notices.
entrevista.p_infancia_1: Where were you born, and what was the house you lived in as a child like?
entrevista.p_infancia_2: Who lived with you? What was an ordinary day at home like?
entrevista.p_infancia_3: What did you play, and with whom?
entrevista.p_infancia_4: What is the first memory you have in life?
entrevista.p_infancia_5: What was school like? Do you remember a teacher or a classmate?
entrevista.p_infancia_6: What smell, food or song takes you straight back to that time?
entrevista.p_infancia_7: What mischief of yours does the family still tell about today?
entrevista.d_pais: Who they were — not only as parents, but as people.
entrevista.p_pais_1: What were your parents' names, and where did they come from?
entrevista.p_pais_3: What did your father do for a living? And your mother?
entrevista.p_pais_4: What manner, habit or phrase of theirs do you still carry today?
entrevista.p_pais_5: What did they teach without having to say it?
entrevista.p_pais_6: What would you have liked to ask them and never did?
entrevista.d_juventude: The age when everything seemed to be starting.
entrevista.p_juventude_1: What was going out, dating and having fun like in your day?
entrevista.p_juventude_3: What song, film or place marked those years?
entrevista.p_juventude_4: What was the first important decision you made on your own?
entrevista.p_juventude_5: What did you dream of becoming?
entrevista.p_juventude_6: Which day from that time would you live again, exactly as it was?
entrevista.d_profissao: A life of work, with its highs and its stumbles.
entrevista.p_profissao_1: What was your first job, and how much did you earn?
entrevista.p_profissao_2: How did you choose what you did for a living — or how did it choose you?
entrevista.p_profissao_3: What are you proudest of in your work?
entrevista.p_profissao_4: What was the hardest part, and how did you get through it?
entrevista.p_profissao_6: What would you do differently if you started today?
entrevista.d_casamento: The meeting, the life together, and what held it up.
entrevista.p_casamento_1: How did you meet? Tell us about that day.
entrevista.p_casamento_2: What were the proposal and the wedding like?
entrevista.p_casamento_3: What was your life like in the beginning?
entrevista.p_casamento_4: What was the hardest stretch, and what held you together?
entrevista.p_casamento_5: What did you learn about living with someone?
entrevista.p_casamento_6: Which moment together do you hold most dearly?
entrevista.d_filhos: From when they arrived to who each one became.
entrevista.p_filhos_1: What was it like when you found out you would be a parent?
entrevista.p_filhos_2: What was the day each child was born like?
entrevista.p_filhos_3: What was each of them like as a child?
entrevista.p_filhos_4: What did you want to pass on to them?
entrevista.p_filhos_6: What would you say to them that you may never have said out loud?
entrevista.d_historicos: What you saw happen, from where you were standing.
entrevista.p_historicos_1: Which event in the country or the world do you remember living through?
entrevista.p_historicos_2: Where were you and what did you feel at that moment?
entrevista.p_historicos_3: What changed in the family's life because of it?
entrevista.p_historicos_4: What has changed most in your life from the beginning until today?
entrevista.p_historicos_5: What did your generation know that today's no longer knows?
entrevista.d_viagens: The places that stayed with you — including the moves.
entrevista.p_viagens_1: What was the most memorable trip of your life?
entrevista.p_viagens_2: Have you ever moved city or country? What was it like?
entrevista.p_viagens_3: Which place would you go back to this very day?
entrevista.p_viagens_4: How did people travel in your day?
entrevista.p_viagens_5: Which travel story does the family always ask you to tell?
entrevista.d_tradicoes: Recipes, celebrations, prayers and the ways of the house.
entrevista.p_tradicoes_1: What were end-of-year celebrations like in your family?
entrevista.p_tradicoes_2: Which recipe belongs to the family, and who taught it to you?
entrevista.p_tradicoes_3: What custom, prayer or superstition did you keep?
entrevista.p_tradicoes_4: Is there a family object passed down through generations?
entrevista.p_tradicoes_5: Where does the surname come from, and what is told about it?
entrevista.p_tradicoes_6: Which tradition are you afraid will be lost?
entrevista.r_conselhos: Advice to those who come after
entrevista.d_conselhos: The message for the next ones — including those not yet born.
entrevista.p_conselhos_1: What did life teach you that you wish you had known earlier?
entrevista.p_conselhos_2: What really matters, in the end?
entrevista.p_conselhos_3: Which mistake would you not want to see your grandchildren repeat?
entrevista.p_conselhos_4: How would you like to be remembered?
entrevista.p_conselhos_5: What do you want to say to someone in the family who is not born yet?

midia.arquivar_confirmar: Delete this memory? It leaves the gallery and search right away and goes to the Bin, from where it can come back whole. What the family wrote about it stays.

midia.original_intacto: The original is never altered. What you see here is a smaller copy.
midia.sem_pessoas: Nobody tagged in this photo yet
midia.sem_pessoas_p: Tagging who appears is what makes this photo show up in each of their pages — and in the family book, one day.

album.intro: An album gathers photos that tell the same thing — a trip, a wedding, grandma's house. The photo stays one: joining an album makes no copy, and it can be in several at once.
album.descricao: A line about what it gathers (optional)
album.nenhum_p: This is the step missing before a scrapbook: gather the photos of one moment into an album, then ask for its book.
album.nenhum_criar: You have no albums yet. Create one now?
album.vazio_p: Open a memory in the gallery and use "Save to an album" to bring it here.
album.como_por: To add: open the photo in the gallery and choose "Save to an album".
album.ja_estava: That photo was already in that album.

busca.placeholder: a name, a place, a word from a story…
busca.nada_p: Try another word or use the filters. Search also looks by meaning, not only by the exact word.
busca.por_sentido_intro: What the exact word did not bring, but says the same thing.
busca.a_indexar: {n} item(s) not yet indexed by meaning

documento.sem_texto: This file has no readable text.
documento.ocr_pendente: This document is an image — the text has not been read yet.
documento.falhou: I could not read this file.
documento.leitura_intro: Origena can read the document — handwriting included — and transcribe what is written. Whatever it finds stays a SUGGESTION: it becomes a family fact only when you say who the paper is about.
documento.transcrito: Transcribed automatically, {n} characters — check before trusting it.
documento.nada_encontrado: The reading found no person data in this document. The transcript is still kept and the document already appears in search.

tempo.sem_itens: Nothing dated yet. Birth dates, photos and stories appear here on their own.
tempo.ocultos: {n} item(s) do not appear for your role.

lugar.nota: What this place means to the family

tradicao.intro: The recipe, the prayer, the song, the phrase and the way of doing it. None of this is on any certificate.
tradicao.sem_tradicoes_p: A recipe, a celebration, a song, a saying, a prayer, a craft: whatever repeats every generation belongs here.
tradicao.manuscrito_nota: The photo of the paper in the handwriting of whoever wrote it stays the original — the text above is a reading of it.
tradicao.aprendizes: Who knows how to make it
tradicao.sem_aprendizes: Nobody recorded yet. This is how a recipe gets lost.
tradicao.sem_transmissoes: Nobody has recorded who taught whom yet.

reliquia.intro: The ring, the watch, the sewing machine. The value is in how many hands it passed through.
reliquia.sem_reliquias_p: The ring, the watch, the sewing machine, the family bible: the object and the line of who kept it over time.
reliquia.linha_de_posse: How many hands it passed through
reliquia.sem_custodia: Nobody knows who has it. That is the first thing to ask.

livro.intro: The archive becomes a PDF to print and keep in a drawer. Paper has no password, depends on no provider and does not expire — it is the oldest way a legacy crosses generations.
livro.recorte: The book shows what YOU can see. Another relative, with another role, would get a different book.
livro.d_familia: One chapter per person, with the facts, the origin of each one, the stories and the traditions.
livro.d_album: An album on paper: one photo per page, with who is in it and where the image came from.
livro.d_ano: What happened in one year and the year in photographs. It reaches what has a date — the rest is declared.
livro.escolher_ano: Which year is the review about?
livro.sem_album: To make a scrapbook you need an album with photos in it. Want to build one now?
livro.so_com_data: The review only reaches what has a date. The book says how many photos were left out for lacking one — dating each of them is what brings them in.
livro.na_fila: Building the book — it takes a moment. It appears here when it is ready.
livro.expira: The link works until {data} — the book can be rebuilt whenever you want.
livro.nenhum_p: The book is built from what is already kept: no typing again. Choose a format above whenever you want to see how it turns out.

plano.intro: What is charged is the archive kept with provenance — not the disk. Inviting relatives is free on every plan: the limit is space and AI operations, never people.
plano.sem_assinatura: You are on the free plan.
plano.manual_titulo: How to subscribe during the beta
plano.manual: Automatic payment is not switched on yet. Talk to Augusto: subscriptions and credits are entered by hand, and the archive is yours either way — you can export everything at any time.
plano.creditos_explica: Credits are only for what actually costs: writing a biography, asking Origena, reading a scanned document. Keeping photos, stories and traditions costs no credit at all.
plano.cancelar_confirma: Cancel the subscription? It stays valid until the end of the period already paid, and the archive stays yours.
plano.pagando: We opened the payment in another tab. As soon as Mercado Pago confirms, the credit arrives on its own.

missao.intro: Every gap in the archive becomes a question. Answering here keeps the answer as a contribution, with your name and the date.
missao.nenhuma: No open questions. Tap refresh to look for new gaps.
missao.resposta_placeholder: What do you know about this?
missao.motivo: Why not ask this? (it stays on the record)
missao.pergunta_pessoa_sem_parentesco: Who are {nome}'s parents, siblings or children?
missao.pergunta_pessoa_sem_foto: Do you have any photograph of {nome}?
missao.pergunta_documento_sem_contexto: What is this document about, and whose is it? ({titulo})
missao.pergunta_divergencia_aberta: The family recorded different versions of {campo} for {nome}. Do you know which one is right?
missao.pergunta_receita_sem_aprendiz: Who in the family knows how to make {titulo}?
missao.pergunta_periodo_pouco_documentado: The {decada} barely appear in the archive. What did the family live through then?
missao.pergunta_generica: There is a gap in the archive waiting for an answer.

indice.intro: A picture of what has been preserved about each person — and, above all, what has not. It is not a competition between anyone.
indice.sem_ranking: The list comes out by name, never by score: the point is to find gaps, not to compare relatives.
indice.quem_sabe_intro: Based on the contributions, photos and stories already recorded.
indice.sem_pistas: We cannot tell yet who knows most about this person.

historiador.titulo: What is missing from the archive
historiador.intro: This is not guesswork: it is what the archive shows to be missing. Each line becomes a question someone in the family can answer.
historiador.sem_lacunas: Nothing missing around here — for now.
historiador.alem_do_teto: There are {n} more of the same kind beyond those shown.
historiador.tipo_pessoa_sem_nascimento: People with no date of birth
historiador.tipo_pessoa_sem_foto: People with no photo at all
historiador.tipo_pessoa_sem_historia: People with no story at all

ia.selo_ia: ✨ Text written with AI help, from the family's own sources
ia.perguntar_campo: What would you like to know?
ia.perguntar_placeholder: Who was my great-grandfather? Which recipes were grandma's?
ia.sem_resposta: The family has not recorded anything about this yet.
ia.indisponivel: This feature is not available yet.

grafo.intro: Everything linked to this record, and why. Every link comes from something someone reported — not from calculated similarity.
grafo.sem_vizinhos: This record is not linked to anything yet. Tagging who appears in a photo or mentioning someone in a story already creates the first link.
grafo.caminho_titulo: How one thing leads to another
grafo.sem_caminho: I found no link between the two within {n} steps. That does not mean it does not exist — it means the archive has not recorded it yet.

estudio.intro: Origena can restore, colourise and enlarge this photo. The ORIGINAL is never altered: every result comes in as a new version, alongside, marked as made by AI.
estudio.restaurar_desc: Removes scratches, stains and noise, and corrects contrast. It does not change faces, clothes or scenery — where the photo was lost, it stays lost.
estudio.colorizar_desc: Gives colour to a black and white photo. The colour is a GUESS: nobody recorded the colour of that dress, and Origena will not pretend otherwise.
estudio.ampliar_desc: More definition, without inventing detail — especially on faces, where a reconstructed eye changes the person.
estudio.animar_desc: Turns the photo into a short, silent video. Different from the other three: here EVERYTHING that moves is invention — that gesture never happened. The video comes out marked as AI-created and never enters a book or an album as a record.
estudio.animar_aviso: Nothing that moves in this video happened. It is an animation made by a computer from a still photograph.
estudio.animar_mudo: Silent on purpose: an invented voice for someone who is gone would be worse than invented movement.
estudio.selo_video: ⚠️ AI-created video from a photo — the movement did not happen
estudio.na_fila: In the queue — the result appears here when it is ready.
estudio.falhou: It did not work: {motivo}. The credit was returned.
estudio.selo: ✨ Made with AI from the original
estudio.selo_cor: ✨ Colour interpreted by AI — not a record of the time
estudio.indisponivel: The Studio is not switched on yet.

guardiao.intro: Guardians are the people who will be able to take over this archive if you are gone. Choosing now is what keeps the decision from falling to whoever happens to be around on the worst day.
guardiao.nada_automatico: Nothing happens on its own. A succession request needs a quorum among the guardians, a review by someone from the platform and a window for objections — and a single guardian who disagrees stops it.
guardiao.voce_e_avisado: If someone opens a request about you, you get an e-mail immediately and can stop it at any moment, even after approval.
guardiao.email: E-mail of the person you want as guardian
guardiao.nenhum: No guardians named. The archive has no succession planned.
guardiao.nenhum_pedido: No succession requests — which is good news.
guardiao.prazo: takes effect on {data} if nobody stops it

mapa.intro: Where the family came from and where it went. Each dot is a place you recorded; the lines follow each person's life, in the order it happened.
mapa.sem_lugares: No places recorded yet. Record the places that matter to the family — the town where someone was born, the farm, the neighbourhood.
mapa.sem_coordenada: These places exist in the archive but have no latitude and longitude yet, so they do not appear on the drawing: {lista}.
mapa.nao_reconhecidos_titulo: Handwritten places that are not places yet
mapa.nao_reconhecidos: They appear in the archive as text and match no recorded place. Recording the place under this name (or as a historic name) links everything at once.

capsula.intro: Almost everything here looks backwards. The capsule is the only thing that goes the other way: you write today to be read many years from now — perhaps when you are no longer here to explain.
capsula.lacre: While it is sealed, nobody reads it: not you, not the account owner. What the family sees is that it exists and when it opens.
capsula.chave: The content is encrypted with a key that does not live in the database.
capsula.campo_recado: A message in the clear, if you like (e.g. "for when you turn 18")
capsula.campo_corpo: The letter — only whoever opens it will read
capsula.por_idade: When someone reaches a certain age
capsula.confirmar_cancelar: Cancelling deletes the capsule and what is inside it, forever. Are you sure?
capsula.so_minhas_fotos: You can only seal photos you sent yourself — a capsule is not for hiding other people's archive.

ajuda.intro: This is the house manual. It explains the decisions that make Origena different from a photo folder — and above all what it does not do, which is usually the surprising part.
ajuda.duvida: Is something missing here? Ask Augusto — this page exists to be corrected.
ajuda.acervo_t: The archive belongs to the family, not to the platform
ajuda.acervo_c:
Everything that comes in here stays yours. At any moment you export the whole archive in one file — data, the tree in GEDCOM format and the photos — and take it away.

That same file comes back: you can import it into a new family, and the photos come with it. This is not a marketing promise; it is tested every time the system is updated.
ajuda.selo_t: Every piece of information carries where it came from
ajuda.selo_c: This is the heart of the product. No data appears loose: each one comes with a badge saying its origin. The certificate records it — there is a document. The family tells it — someone remembers, and the name of who remembered stays with it. Suggested by AI, unconfirmed — the machine proposed it and no human confirmed. These are different things, and Origena never mixes them. An AI suggestion never becomes a fact on its own: someone in the family has to accept it, and that acceptance is recorded with a name and a date.
ajuda.divergencia_c: The aunt says grandfather was born in 1921; the cousin says 1922. Origena does not choose on its own and deletes neither version. The fact is marked as disputed, both versions stay visible with who said each one, and the family decides — writing down the reason. If the certificate turns up later, it promotes the documented version, and the earlier decision stays in the history. Correcting here is never deleting: it is adding a new version on top.
ajuda.privacidade_c:
Every person in the family joins with a role. Contributors add but do not delete — family conflict is an expected situation, not an exception.

Items marked private appear only to whoever created them and to whoever administers (and in that case the access is recorded). A child's profile is born private and never goes public.

A guest sees only what the family marked as public: no documents, nothing private, no capsules.
ajuda.fotos_t: What AI does with photos — and what it never does
ajuda.fotos_c: The photo you uploaded is never altered. Each treatment creates a new version, alongside, clearly marked. Restore removes scratches, stains and noise. It does not change faces, clothes or scenery: where the photo was lost, it stays lost — missing information is better than invented information. Colourise gives colour to a black and white photo. The colour is a guess: nobody recorded the colour of that dress, and the badge says so. Enlarge increases definition without inventing detail, especially on faces — a reconstructed eye changes the person. Animate is the only one that invents: it turns the photo into a short, silent video. That movement never happened. That is why the video comes out marked as AI-created and does not enter a book or an album as though it were a record. The video has no sound on purpose: an invented voice for someone who is gone would be worse than invented movement.
ajuda.datas_c: "In the 40s", "around 1890", "before moving to Brasília". Origena accepts an imprecise date and keeps the imprecision, instead of guessing an exact day. The timeline orders by what it knows and shows the precision alongside. Whatever has no date at all goes to the end, labelled — never pretending an order the data does not support.
ajuda.capsula_c: Almost everything here looks backwards. The capsule goes the other way: you write today to be read many years from now. While it is sealed, nobody reads it — not you, not the account owner. What the family sees is that it exists, who wrote it and when it opens. The content is encrypted with a key that does not live in the database. An attached photo disappears from the gallery and from search until it opens, and comes back to exactly the privacy it had before. You can only seal photos you sent yourself: the capsule is not for hiding other people's archive.
ajuda.guardioes_c: Guardians are the people who can take over the archive if you are gone. Nothing happens automatically: a request needs a quorum among the guardians, a review by a person from the platform, and a window for objections — and a single guardian who disagrees stops it. You are notified by e-mail and can stop it yourself at any time, even after approval.
ajuda.livros_c:
The archive becomes a PDF to print. Paper has no password, depends on no provider and does not expire.

Every book is the view of whoever asked for it: two relatives with different roles get different books. The colophon says what is an account, what is a document and what came from a machine.
ajuda.creditos_t: What costs and what does not
ajuda.creditos_c: AI operations use credits: restoring, colourising, enlarging and animating a photo, transcribing an interview, writing a biography. The price appears first. You see what it costs, you confirm, and only then does the amount leave the wallet. If the model refuses the work — which happens, and is a legitimate answer — the credit comes back automatically. No credit is charged for: keeping, searching (including search by meaning), the tree, the timeline, the PDF books and exporting the archive. That is the family's own archive, not a machine operation.
ajuda.erro_c:
A photo that will not open, an import that fails, a job stuck: the system would rather say it broke than pretend it worked. If a file did not upload, the media stays marked as pending instead of appearing ready and empty.

What the family sees as an error always has a reason written in plain language. If the reason does not help you understand what to do, that is a defect in the system — worth telling us.

site.como_p: Four movements, in the order memory actually happens — nobody starts with a complete family tree.
site.passo_guardar: Photos, videos, audio, documents and letters. The original stays exactly as it arrived: Origena never replaces what you sent.
site.passo_contar: Who is in it, when it was, what happened that day. One sentence is enough, and it keeps the name of who told it and the date.
site.passo_ligar: People, places, times and objects connect to each other. The same photo appears on the page of everyone in it, without becoming a copy.
site.passo_criar: Out of the archive come books, albums and year reviews in PDF — with nothing typed again.
site.recursos_p: What exists today, working, in the closed beta.
site.rec_proveniencia: Each piece of information keeps where it came from: who told it, which document proved it, when it arrived. When two people remember differently, both versions stay — neither is deleted.
site.rec_midia: Direct, secure upload, an immutable original, a thumbnail made on your own device, and the file checked byte by byte before entering the archive.
site.rec_entrevistas: Ten question guides and recording on your own phone. The original audio is never replaced, and the transcript can be corrected by hand.
site.rec_tradicoes: Recipes with the handwritten page beside the transcript, crafts with the chain of who taught whom, and objects with the line of who kept them over time.
site.rec_busca: It looks by word and also by meaning — and never shows what your role in the family cannot see.
site.rec_capsula: A letter written today to be read decades from now. While it is sealed, nobody reads it: not you, not the account owner.
site.rec_guardioes: Who looks after the archive if you no longer can. Nothing happens automatically: there is a quorum, an objection window and a human review.
site.rec_livro: The archive becomes a PDF to print. Paper has no password, depends on no provider and does not expire.
site.rec_privacidade: Seven roles, from owner to guest. A child's profile is born closed, and any item can be more restricted than the rest.
site.rec_saida: A complete export in open formats, with the photos included and the tree in GEDCOM. Leaving is a right, not a favour.
site.familia_p1: Origena was built for what actually happens in a family: the aunt who remembers everyone's name, the grandfather who tells the same story differently every Christmas, the box of photos nobody can date.
site.familia_p2: That is why an approximate date is a valid answer, a differing version is not an error, and someone who just wants to send a photo can send a photo — with no form to fill in.
site.familia_p3: Built to be used on a phone, by people of every age: large text, generous targets, and no screen that depends on knowing where to click.
site.criacoes_p: Everything the family kept can become an object — without retyping anything:
site.criacao_livro: A family book, with one chapter per person and the origin of every piece of information
site.criacao_pessoa: A book about one person, to give as a present
site.criacao_album: A scrapbook of an album, one photo per page
site.criacao_ano: A year in review, with what happened and the year in photographs
site.criacao_capsula: A time capsule, to open on a date or at an age
site.criacoes_nota: Every book is the view of whoever asked for it: two relatives with different roles get different books, and the colophon says what is an account, what is a document and what came from a machine.
site.planos_p: Prices come from the same place billing uses — what is here is what is charged.
site.planos_nota: AI credits are for transcribing interviews, reading scanned documents and restoring photos. Nothing already kept depends on them: the archive stays readable, exportable and yours, on any plan.
